phenomenon: After observed liquidation deleveraging, a confirmed break and retest of newly formed post-shock H4 structure may identify delayed continuation or reversal opportunities that a pre-shock-boundary retest misses.
economic_behavioral_mechanism: Margin-constrained forced closers transfer risk urgently. Subsequent two-sided trading may form observable local swing structure before a delayed recovery or continuing repricing. Confirmation and patient retests seek that delayed adjustment; daily aggregation may already consume it.

post_shock_entry.event_detection: Unchanged daily liquidation, ATR-displacement and OI-contraction gates; same geometry inventory.
post_shock_entry.pivot: Strict five-consecutive-H4-bar high/low with two bars on each side; center.start >= selected shock geometry end.
post_shock_entry.availability: A five-H4 pivot becomes available only at the fifth source bar close/eventTime. That pivot availability must be <= the first break-confirmation H4 bar start. First break-confirmation bar.start >= modeled daily availability. Both break confirmations become actionable only at their closes. Retrospective eligible pivots may be selected from stored history.
post_shock_entry.first_confirmation: After daily signal availability, latest eligible confirmed pivot HIGH may support LONG if H4 close strictly above it; latest pivot LOW may support SHORT if close strictly below it. If both directions qualify, ambiguous/no candidate. No requirement to recross from the opposite side after daily availability. Latest means greatest center.start among eligible pivots, separately by high/low.
post_shock_entry.second_confirmation: Freeze pivot identity, price and direction at first qualifying close. A consecutive next H4 close must remain strictly beyond that same level. On gap or failure reset and evaluate current bar as possible first confirmation against pivots already available at the current bar START. Do not move the candidate level during its two-close confirmation.
post_shock_entry.branch: Confirmed direction matching shock direction is CONTINUATION; opposite is REVERSAL. Old pre-shock boundary remains event/recovery metadata, not the revised route/entry level.
post_shock_entry.entry: Freeze zone at selected pivot +/-0.25 pre-event H4 ATR. Retain H1 zone touch, trade-side close and prior-hour extreme break; H1 bar must start at/after second-H4 confirmation availability. Next-hour execution/chase cap0.5ATR around NEW zone center remains unchanged.
post_shock_entry.deadline: Original72h from daily availability to branch confirmation; original72h from branch confirmation for first entry.
post_shock_entry.invalidation: Before first fill, completed H4 close strictly below zone.lower for LONG or strictly above zone.upper for SHORT cancels branch/pending intent. No rerouting for same setup.
post_shock_entry.reversal_target: Keep original prior-range midpoint and cost-adjusted >=1R execution gate. No new target fitted to returns.
post_shock_entry.source_evidence: Persist all five pivot-source bars, confirmation bars, level/zone identity and availability; no future pivot confirmation.

h4_structural_stop.rule: Initial stop from last three consecutive completed/available H4 bars at H1 decision: LONG minimum low minus0.1pre-eventATR, SHORT maximum high plus0.1ATR. Missing bars/adverse-stop failure rejects intent.
h4_structural_stop.sizing: Same1/1.5/2.5%tranche risk and5%position/10%portfolio caps; wider distance reduces quantity.
h4_structural_stop.unchanged: Continuation trail remains three-H4 ratchet; reversal midpoint exit; 60days from firstfill; 2/2/3x leverage.

refreshed_staging.trigger: Only after existing frozen addition zone is invalidated by tightened active stop. Valid zones stay frozen.
refreshed_staging.replacement: Clear unsafe zone/candidate; seek a strict safe five-H4 pivot whose center is strictly after lastfill and later than invalidated pivot center, and whose confirmation is strictly after invalidation time. Retain existing favorable-H4 prerequisite.
refreshed_staging.invariants: Never loosen stop, reset firstfill clock, increase stage count, bypass pending order, add after target or exceed any risk/margin cap. Each invalidation/replacement is auditable.
refreshed_staging.pending: Preserve an already-pending addition intent unchanged; defer replacement while pending. Existing execution/risk/stop checks still decide fill. On fill, normal next-stage cycle supersedes prior-stage refresh request. On no-fill, next eligible H4 may seek replacement under the frozen timing constraints. Preserve the first invalidation timestamp while awaiting replacement; later ratchets do not overwrite it.
